name: poundlock-dispatch-gui
description: Poundlock Dispatch: plan, delegate and review work on your projects with a Project Manager and Pi workers, using models served by Poundlock.
author: Michael Anderson

scripts.package: electron-vite build && npm run -s notices && node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron-builder --mac dir zip --publish never
scripts.package:dir: electron-vite build && npm run -s notices && node node_modules/electron/install.js && node scripts/close-package-output.cjs && electron-builder --mac dir --publish never
scripts.package:linux: electron-vite build && npm run -s notices && node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.auto: npm run -s tui:build && node out/tui/index.js auto
